detail: Supplemental release C343310 adds 7,959 rows / 7,671 transaction IDs; no transaction ID appears in both releases. Every posting month January 2018-September 2026 now has rows.

field: CH Signoff Full Name / CH Signoff Date
issue: Columns swapped: name stored in the date column, Excel date serial stored in the name column
detail: One contiguous block (original sheet Excel rows 109880-111116, posted Jul-Sep 2026). Swapped back; serials converted to timestamps (2026-07-15 08:31:37 to 2026-10-05 16:05:10), all 1-39 days after posting and before manager sign-off.

field: GL: Fund, GL: Department, GL: Unit, GL: Object, GL: Activity, MCC
issue: Codes stored as numbers in some rows and text in others (changes by year and by release)
detail: All codes stored as text. GL: Fund, GL: Department, GL: Unit, GL: Object, GL: Activity had mixed types.

issue: Numeric 0 used where there is no manager sign-off
detail: Set to blank. Every such row also has a blank Mgr Signoff Date.

issue: Code 0 used as a placeholder (transaction never allocated to an account)
detail: Set to blank and flagged; descriptions on these rows are also blank.

issue: Code 0 used as a placeholder (transaction never allocated to an account)
detail: Set to blank and flagged; descriptions on these rows are also blank.

issue: Activity code is not four digits
detail: Value(s): 587. The intended code cannot be determined.

issue: Blank department
detail: Filled with 1100: every other row in all three sheets is department 1100 (Austin Energy).

field: Vendor Name, Item Description, GL: Unit Desc, GL: Object Desc, GL: Activity Desc, ...
issue: Leading/trailing spaces, repeated spaces, and line breaks inside text cells
detail: Trimmed; runs of whitespace collapsed to a single space (16 descriptions contained line breaks). Merchant descriptors such as 'PAYPAL  ATXSOLUTION' become 'PAYPAL ATXSOLUTION'.

issue: Same country coded several ways (US / USA / 840; PR / PRI; CA / CAN; NL / NLD; SG / SGP; 0)
detail: Standardized to ISO 3166 alpha-3. 'CA' rows have Canadian provinces; the three '0' rows are in Texas.

issue: Value is not a two-letter state code
detail: Foreign region codes and card-network placeholders (00, AUS, B, CAM, CO., CYP, DEU, DUB, ENG, FRA, GBR, HKG, KOW, LND, NLD, NSW, PRI).

issue: City field holds a phone number, URL, or e-mail address instead of a city
detail: Normal for card-not-present and payment-facilitator merchants; the value is itself informative.

issue: Description blank, replaced by a lookup placeholder, or capitalised inconsistently
detail: 38 blank and 2,044 placeholder ('Multiple unit descriptions from various departments') descriptions filled from the same code's description on other rows, only where that code has exactly one description; 15 capitalisation variants set to the most common spelling.

issue: Description still blank, placeholder, or different from the code's usual description
detail: 1 blank with no usable lookup, 0 placeholder, 82 where the same code carries a genuinely different description (the chart of accounts changed over time, or code and description were keyed separately).

issue: Description blank, replaced by a lookup placeholder, or capitalised inconsistently
detail: 2 blank and 0 placeholder ('Multiple unit descriptions from various departments') descriptions filled from the same code's description on other rows, only where that code has exactly one description; 467 capitalisation variants set to the most common spelling.

issue: Description still blank, placeholder, or different from the code's usual description
detail: 18 blank with no usable lookup, 0 placeholder, 225 where the same code carries a genuinely different description (the chart of accounts changed over time, or code and description were keyed separately).

issue: Description blank, replaced by a lookup placeholder, or capitalised inconsistently
detail: 2,728 blank and 0 placeholder ('Multiple unit descriptions from various departments') descriptions filled from the same code's description on other rows, only where that code has exactly one description; 0 capitalisation variants set to the most common spelling.

issue: Description still blank, placeholder, or different from the code's usual description
detail: 769 blank with no usable lookup, 0 placeholder, 0 where the same code carries a genuinely different description (the chart of accounts changed over time, or code and description were keyed separately).

issue: Same cardholder under two spellings (middle name dropped, mostly in rows posted July-September 2026)
detail: 47 short names mapped to the longer spelling when the given names are a prefix of exactly one longer name with the same surname (e.g. 'Gray, Julia' -> 'Gray, Julia M'). Released spelling kept in cardholder_name_as_released. Names that differ in a middle initial are left separate.

issue: Not an allocation: the full transaction amount is repeated on every line of a multi-line transaction
detail: All 1,716 multi-line transactions carry one identical amount on every line (e.g. a $103.18 grocery purchase listed on 47 item lines). Summing the column overstates spending by $2,037,872.39. Added txn_line_number, txn_line_count and is_primary_line; total spending = SUM(amount) WHERE is_primary_line. Amounts themselves are unchanged.

issue: Line is identical in every released field to an earlier line of the same transaction
detail: 71 transactions. Kept, and flagged in is_exact_duplicate_line. Because the amount is a repeated transaction total (W17), these lines do not inflate spending once is_primary_line is used.

issue: Transaction ID carries a -A/-B/-C suffix
detail: 10 card charges were split in Works into separately coded parts; here the parts DO carry different amounts that add up to the charge. txn_id_base holds the ID without the suffix.

issue: No cardholder sign-off recorded
detail: Counted in transactions. 1,476 were posted July-September 2026 and were probably still open when the data was extracted.

issue: No manager sign-off recorded
detail: Counted in transactions. 1,476 were posted July-September 2026. Absence in the extract does not prove the purchase was never reviewed.

issue: Posted more than 30 days after purchase
detail: Mostly dispute and claim adjustments. No transaction posts before its purchase date, and no sign-off precedes posting.

issue: Redundant column
detail: Identical to MCC on every row. Kept under the name supplier_mcc for fidelity to the release.

issue: Characters outside plain ASCII (accents, curly quotes, dashes)
detail: Valid Unicode; files are written as UTF-8.

issue: Truncated at 40 characters, with source typos (e.g. 'NOT ESLEWHERE CLASSI')
detail: Card-network text as released.

issue: Merchant name and purchase description packed into one fixed-width field
detail: Characters 1-30 -> vendor_name, 31-100 -> item_description (whitespace trimmed).

issue: Purchase description cut off at 70 characters
detail: The field is capped at 100 characters in the source system.

issue: Cardholder name written 'FIRST MIDDLE LAST' in capitals; newer system uses 'Last, First Middle'
detail: 227 names converted to the newer format so a cardholder can be followed across both systems: 130 matched a newer-system name exactly, 11 matched on first and last name (unique match), 86 do not appear in the newer system and were reformatted assuming the final word is the surname. Released spelling kept in cardholder_name_as_released.

issue: No calendar dates; fiscal month 1 never appears and month 12 holds about twice the usual volume
detail: Each row is a line of a monthly ProCard journal voucher, dated only by accounting period. Dates quoted inside descriptions fall mostly in the calendar month before the period, so period N holds roughly the statement for month N-1 and period 12 holds two statements (year-end accrual). No dates were invented.

issue: Probable gap of about one statement cycle between the two systems (December 2017)
detail: Legacy rows end at fiscal year 2018 period 3 (December 2017 accounting period, purchases to about late November 2017). Newer-system rows start with post date 2018-01-02 (purchase dates from 2017-12-27). Purchases posted in December 2017 appear in neither sheet; a follow-up request would be needed.

issue: Different grain and fields from the newer system
detail: Legacy rows have no transaction ID, dates, merchant category, or sign-off data. Amounts are per accounting line and can be summed. Use source_system to keep the two populations apart.
